# The Nutrition Source

> > Harvard's evidence-based nutrition resource providing dietary guidelines, food science education, and healthy eating recommendations grounded in peer-reviewed research.

The Nutrition Source is Harvard School of Public Health's authoritative guide to nutrition and dietary science. It offers comprehensive, research-backed information on healthy eating patterns, specific nutrients, and disease prevention through nutrition, serving as a trusted resource for both the general public and health professionals.

## Key Topics

- Healthy Eating Plate
- Dietary Guidelines for Americans
- Evidence-based nutrition
- Heart disease prevention
- Whole grains
- Unsaturated fats
- Vitamin D
- Protein sources
- Disease prevention
- Balanced diet
- Vegetables and fruits
- Dietary fat types
- Planetary Health Diet
- Nutrition education
- Micronutrients

## Core Nutrition Guides

- [Home](https://nutritionsource.hsph.harvard.edu): Harvard's Nutrition Source homepage with guides on healthy eating and dietary science
- [What Should I Eat?](https://nutritionsource.hsph.harvard.edu/what-should-you-eat): Harvard's dietary recommendations for healthy eating and nutrition guidance
- [Healthy Eating Plate](https://nutritionsource.hsph.harvard.edu/healthy-eating-plate): Healthy Eating Plate visual guide for balanced meal planning and nutrition
- [Kid's Healthy Eating Plate](https://nutritionsource.hsph.harvard.edu/kids-healthy-eating-plate): Visual nutrition guide for children's healthy eating and physical activity
- [About The Nutrition Source](https://nutritionsource.hsph.harvard.edu/about): About The Nutrition Source mission, editorial policy, and scientific integrity

## Macronutrients and Food Groups

- [Fats and Cholesterol](https://nutritionsource.hsph.harvard.edu/what-should-you-eat/fats-and-cholesterol): Dietary fat types and cholesterol effects on health based on research
- [Types of Fat](https://nutritionsource.hsph.harvard.edu/what-should-you-eat/fats-and-cholesterol/types-of-fat): Unsaturated, saturated, and omega-3 fats explained with health benefits
- [Cholesterol](https://nutritionsource.hsph.harvard.edu/what-should-you-eat/fats-and-cholesterol/cholesterol): Blood cholesterol, LDL, HDL, and lipoprotein science explained
- [Dietary Fat and Disease](https://nutritionsource.hsph.harvard.edu/what-should-you-eat/fats-and-cholesterol/dietary-fat-and-disease): How dietary fat types affect diabetes, heart disease, and cancer risk
- [Protein](https://nutritionsource.hsph.harvard.edu/what-should-you-eat/protein): Protein basics, sources, amino acids, and dietary requirements explained
- [Whole Grains](https://nutritionsource.hsph.harvard.edu/what-should-you-eat/whole-grains): Guide to whole grains benefits and recommendations vs refined grains
- [Vegetables and Fruits](https://nutritionsource.hsph.harvard.edu/what-should-you-eat/vegetables-and-fruits): Benefits of vegetables and fruits for disease prevention and health

## Vitamins, Minerals, and Beverages

- [Vitamins and Minerals](https://nutritionsource.hsph.harvard.edu/vitamins): Vitamins, minerals, micronutrients, and dietary reference intakes guide
- [Healthy Drinks](https://nutritionsource.hsph.harvard.edu/healthy-drinks): Guide to healthy beverage choices including water, coffee, and tea
- [How Much Water Do You Need?](https://nutritionsource.hsph.harvard.edu/water): Daily water intake recommendations and hydration guidelines
- [Other Healthy Beverage Options](https://nutritionsource.hsph.harvard.edu/healthy-drinks/other-healthy-beverage-options): Benefits of tea and coffee with antioxidants and health effects
- [Sugary Drinks](https://nutritionsource.hsph.harvard.edu/healthy-drinks/sugary-drinks): Health risks of sugary and sugar-sweetened beverages explained
- [Drinks to Consume in Moderation](https://nutritionsource.hsph.harvard.edu/healthy-drinks/drinks-to-consume-in-moderation): Moderation guidelines for diet drinks, juice, milk, and alcohol

## News and Updates

- [Nutrition News](https://nutritionsource.hsph.harvard.edu/nutrition-news): Latest nutrition news and dietary guidelines updates from Harvard research

## Optional Resources

- [Healthy Eating Plate Translations](https://nutritionsource.hsph.harvard.edu/healthy-eating-plate/translations): Multilingual translations of Healthy Eating Plate for international audiences
